items.difficulty_reason: 8 行陈述（9 行证明）、完美闭包下循环群余核 p-幂挠：自由基观察 + homeomorphism ⇒ 单射带挠余核（一句压缩，软点注记收：对角正整数矩阵论证为标准）+ p-幂升级由已收卡 0H4F 承担。2 处引用全具名，无 omit，收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-how-different (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 363-370

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Both cycle groups are free abelian on integral closed subschemes of dimension r; the perfect-closure morphism is a homeomorphism, so the pullback identifies the bases up to positive multiplicities, whence injectivity with torsion cokernel; and each cokernel element is p-power torsion by the multiplicities-field-extension lemma, which computes the multiplicities along field extensions (source lines 372-380)
